abstract: This question has been presented to me several times. In a society where we find ourselves, consciously or unconsciously, measuring things by size more often than not, it is tempting to define the success of a Section by numbers, members, activities, or attendees. Sure, these are all viable measures, but expectations are another. The expectations of our members in each Section truly define success. A Section is successful if we are meeting the needs of members.
